shortDescription: Resource module for Ipam Server Setting

options.name: catalystcenter_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: catalystcenter_password
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center password to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_username
options.description: The Cisco Catalyst Center username to authenticate.

options.name: catalystcenter_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: catalystcenter_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco Catalyst Center to use.

options.name: password
options.description: The password for the external IPAM server login username.

options.name: provider
options.description: Type of external IPAM. Can be either INFOBLOX, BLUECAT or GENERIC.

options.name: serverName
options.description: A descriptive name of this external server, used for identification purposes.

options.name: serverUrl
options.description: The URL of this external server.

options.name: syncView
options.description: Synchronize the IP pools from the local IPAM to this external server.

options.name: userName
options.description: The external IPAM server login username.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco Catalyst Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.

options.name: view
options.description: The view under which pools are created in the external IPAM server.
